title: Stage-image subpresheaf of the limit inverse image
statement: For a small category $J$, a diagram $F:J\to\mathrm{Cat}$ and a cocone $V$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], precoverages $P_j,Q$ and continuous transition and cocone functors [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], fix $i$, a sheaf $G$ and maps $\alpha_t:F(t.hom)_sG\to V_{t.right}^sH$ for $t\in\mathrm{Under}(i)$, where $H=V_{i,s}G$. Define the subpresheaf $S\subset H$ by $S(Y)=\{x\mid\exists t,W,f:Y\to V_{t.right}W,z\in(F(t.hom)_sG)(W),\ H(f)(\alpha_t(z))=x\}$. Its restriction maps are the restrictions of $H$.

def colimitSiteStageImage
    {J : Type u} [SmallCategory J] (F : J ⥤ Cat.{u, u})
    (P : ∀ j : J, Precoverage (F.obj j)) (V : Cocone F) (Q : Precoverage V.pt)
    [∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k),
      (F.map a).toFunctor.IsContinuous (P j).toGrothendieck (P k).toGrothendieck]
    [∀ j : J, (V.ι.app j).toFunctor.IsContinuous
      (P j).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck]
    (i : J) (G : Sheaf (P i).toGrothendieck (Type u))
    (α : ∀ t : Under i,
                (sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor (Type u)
                  (P i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G ⟶
                ((V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type u)
                  (P t.right).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck).obj
                  ((sheafPullback (V.ι.app i).toFunctor (Type u)
                    (P i).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck).obj G))
    : Subfunctor ((sheafPullback (V.ι.app i).toFunctor (Type u)
      (P i).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck).obj G).obj
